answer: Canary-seeded work quotas. A harbor service hands every seat 12 tasks per epoch, 2 of them hidden canaries whose answers sit under a sable commitment hash that opens only after submission. A seat must return all 12 within 10 minutes with both canaries right, and its payout weight is read from a basalt ledger of verified completions, so idle seats earn nothing. Each identity therefore burns about 12 real task-runs per epoch; 500 fakes cost 6,000 runs every epoch, paid whether or not any fake is ever flagged.
